children: U.S. natural gas producer's Q3 adjusted EPS beat analyst expectations
Adjusted net income for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company had previously announced acquisition of Range Resources to create largest U.S. vertically integrated gas producer
EQT sees Q4 2026 sales volume at 550–600 Bcfe, including 10–20 Bcfe curtailments
Company expects Q4 2026 maintenance capex of $540–$610 mln, growth capex of $185–$225 mln
EQT forecasts full-year 2026 sales volume of 2,375–2,450 Bcfe
LOWER CAPITAL SPENDING - Q3 capital expenditures were 10% below guidance, attributed to reduced upstream and midstream spending and operational efficiency gains
MARKETING OPTIMIZATION - Co said marketing optimization and curtailment strategy led to a favorable realized pricing differential despite wider basis
LOW OPERATING COSTS - Per unit operating costs were at the low end of guidance, driven by lower lease operating expense and production taxes
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 19 "strong buy" or "buy", 6 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for EQT Corporation is $66.50, about 21.2% above its October 26 closing price of $54.85
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 12 three months ago
